title: BidBrief
description: Output of the Intake Analyst (+ both researchers + Win-Theme Strategist). The 'clean brief out' of the ramble-in pattern. Approved by a human at Gate 1 (Strategy). Frozen context that all downstream agents condition on.

role.description: Declared document role (P15/B67 §3): core = the one document you would read if you read only one; supplemental = added context; target = the artifact the response must fill. NOT inferable from the upload — declared at deposit or asked at gate_0.

ramble_context.description: Free-form context from the pursuit lead (voice/text), verbatim.

gaps.description: The intake questions, persisted (P15/B70 — run-log gap lines alone could never be answered). Same gap_id vocabulary as the emitted lines; origin separates the deterministic completeness checks from the advisory questioner, whose questions gate NOTHING (E5/A4).

target.description: Dotted brief path the question is about (e.g. procurement.deadlines); absent for questions with no single field.

assumptions.description: The assumption register (P15/B70): every inference the intake MODEL made, listed for human confirmation at gate_0 — a confident-but-wrong inference is worse than a gap because it never announces itself. source=code marks values code parsed deterministically (weights, dates); they are shown, not confirmable.

field.description: Dotted brief path, e.g. procurement.what_is_bought or requirements_matrix[3].weight_text.

value.description: The inferred value as written to the brief (any JSON type).

corrected_to.description: The human's replacement value when status=corrected.

org_id.description: P17/C2 (B75§2): the workspace org registry key linking this pursuit to per-organization memory. HUMAN-LINKED at gate_0 (approve_gate0's org step — the declared-not-inferred precedent of document roles), never model-inferred; buyer.name stays the free display string. Stamped pre-freeze so it rides into brief.frozen.json. Opaque id — org names live in the registry's file content, never in ids.

profile.description: Who they are, mission language, strategic context — fuels tailoring.

terminology.description: Buyer's own terms to mirror (left-hand rule).

research_findings.description: Cited findings from both researchers (B21(2); B23): source_kind discriminates internal_kb / research_pack / web, source is the kb_id or URL the citedness gate verified. topic stays a free string — the out-of-vocab landing value is the literal 'other'.

detail.description: Optional elaboration — absent, never empty, when the researcher gave none.

response_structure.description: Drives the Path A / Path B fork.

red_flags.description: Typed, first-class flags (B17; WP2/T1/C2/C3): injection screen hits, AI-use/disclosure/originality clauses, independence/OCI (flag and hand off — never adjudicated), hidden buyer-file content, plus the original onerous-term family.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote from the buyer document.

routed_to.description: independence_oci only: the conflicts process. The shape carries no adjudication field by design (C3).

requirements_matrix.description: Extracted requirements with the buyer's evaluation weights — carried forward from v1. Steers red-team scoring lens and reviewer attention (and drafting depth when effort_allocation=weighted).

weight.description: Evaluation weight if stated, verbatim-as-stated (30 for '30%'), never normalized — normalization is a downstream computation (B17).

weight_basis.description: B17: disambiguates weight. Required by code (not schema) whenever weight is present.

weight_text.description: The buyer's weight statement exactly as written (B17 verbatim evidence; P15) — the model source the parsed weight came from, and the assumption register's correction target. Retained even when unparseable.

candidates.description: The 6–8 generated angles, including killed ones (kept for the record).

candidate_id.description: Stable id (cand_NN, code-assigned in generation order) — B22(11)/B37(E2): Gate-1 edits address candidates by this id; index addressing cannot survive a re-rendered list. Required by code on every written candidate.

cites.description: Finding sources (buyer.research_findings[].source values) this theme rests on (B23). Required by code on every model-authored candidate; human-added candidates at Gate 1 may omit it (B17 weight_basis pattern).

kill_reason.description: The judge's (or Gate-1 human's) reason this candidate died — kept with the retained candidate so the artifact, not a checkpoint, carries the record (B5, B23).

fit_signals.description: EMPTY HOOK for the deferred go/no-go scoring project. Populate later without schema redesign.

request_sha256.description: Digest of the semantic decision request (decision, notes, edits/answers/corrections/skips, org, gates_collapsed — never the clock or per-submission transport). Written at the stamp so a mid-gate crash resubmit converges on the SAME request and refuses a different one (P25 item 1, register P0-5). Optional: a stamp without it converges on (status, actor) alone.

gate0.description: The intake-review stamp (P15/B70, mirror of gate1). gate_0 is checkpoint-keyed — no status value; this block is the artifact-side record that a human confirmed the engine's reading of the package before research spent anything.

request_sha256.description: Digest of the semantic decision request (decision, notes, edits/answers/corrections/skips, org, gates_collapsed — never the clock or per-submission transport). Written at the stamp so a mid-gate crash resubmit converges on the SAME request and refuses a different one (P25 item 1, register P0-5). Optional: a stamp without it converges on (status, actor) alone.
